outputRules: Create patch writes exactly one output file.
Success never leaves a zero-byte file.
Failure removes the temporary output and leaves an existing destination untouched.
Apply patch runs git apply --check before mutation and captures a recovery snapshot.

scopes.when: One or more unstaged files are selected and no line selection exists
One or more staged files are selected and no line selection exists
Changes mode has no selection and Unstaged is focused
Changes mode has no selection and Staged is focused
The user chooses HEAD versus working tree
One commit is selected, or Create patch is chosen in the diff of one commit
scopes.paths: Limited to the open file when the diff shows one file; a renamed file includes its previous path. The filename is then 0001-{slug}-{basename}.patch

scopes.when: A contiguous first-parent chain of two or more commits is selected
A two-commit comparison is active, or Create patch is chosen in its diff
scopes.paths: Limited to the open file when the diff shows one file; a renamed file includes its previous path. The filename is then {old}-{new}-{basename}.patch

disabled.reason: Selection is not a contiguous first-parent chain. Select a range or compare two commits.
The selected change has no textual patch representation.
The working tree has no changes.
Wait for the current index-changing operation to finish.
The selected path is no longer present in the current generation.
